description: Check an agent rules file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, system prompt) for 12 safeguards an unattended agent needs (kill switch, spending limit, untrusted-input rule, secrets, memory, audit...). Keyword checks: they report what is written down, not what is enforced. Also flags live-looking API keys and hardcoded URLs/IDs that can go stale. Pass the file's text; nothing is stored.

text.description: The full text of the rules file

name: lint_rules_file
title: Lint an agent rules file
